metaTitle: Jaguar Engine Failure Repair | Jaguar Garage
metaDescription: Jaguar engine failure repair specialists. We assess, strip down, and rebuild failed Jaguar engines. Get a detailed inspection report and fixed-price quote.
lede: When a Jaguar engine has already failed, our workshop takes over. We don't diagnose the cause — we assess the damage, strip the engine, identify what can be saved, and give you a clear path forward.

blocks.html: When a Jaguar engine has already failed, our workshop takes over. We don't diagnose the cause — we assess the damage, strip the engine, identify what can be saved, and give you a clear path forward.

The process begins the moment your vehicle arrives. We carry out a full visual inspection of the engine bay and ancillaries, then remove the engine for a complete strip-down. Every component is cleaned, measured, and inspected against factory tolerances. We then prepare a detailed report with photographs, a repair plan, and a fixed-price quote for the work needed.
If you choose to proceed, we machine, replace, and rebuild the engine to our standard specification, then refit it and road-test the vehicle before handover.

steps.title: Initial inspection & vehicle arrival
steps.body: We visually inspect the engine bay and ancillaries, then remove the engine for full assessment.

steps.title: Full strip-down & cleaning
steps.body: Every component is dismantled, degreased, and cleaned to reveal the true condition of each part.

steps.title: Component measurement & inspection
steps.body: We measure crankshafts, camshafts, bearings, pistons, and cylinder bores against factory tolerances.

steps.title: Diagnostic report & fixed-price quote
steps.body: You receive a detailed report with photos, a repair plan, and a clear fixed-price quote before any work begins.

steps.title: Machining & parts replacement
steps.body: We machine the block, crank, and cylinder head as needed, and replace all worn or out-of-spec components.

steps.title: Rebuild, refit & road test
steps.body: The engine is reassembled with new bearings, seals, and gaskets, refitted, and the vehicle is road-tested before handover.

items.q: What happens when my Jaguar arrives for engine failure repair?
items.a: We carry out a visual inspection, then remove the engine for a full strip-down. Every component is cleaned, measured, and inspected. You receive a detailed report with photos and a fixed-price quote before any work begins.

items.q: How long does the assessment take?
items.a: The strip-down and inspection typically takes 1–2 working days. We then prepare your report and quote. The overall timeframe depends on the engine condition and the extent of the work needed.

items.q: Do you provide a warranty on the rebuild?
items.a: Yes. All our engine rebuilds come with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour.
Yes. We offer nationwide recovery for Jaguar vehicles. [Learn more about our recovery service →](/jaguar-engine-recovery)

items.q: What if the engine is beyond repair?
items.a: If the engine block or cylinder head is beyond machining or replacement, we will advise you on the best course of action — typically engine replacement. We supply and fit replacement engines.
